trap.label: that × what
trap.wrong: It was the weather what delayed the launch.
trap.right: It was the weather that delayed the launch.
trap.why: Em português “foi o clima que atrasou” usa que, e o aluno às vezes escolhe what. Em inglês, it-cleft usa that (ou who); what abre o wh-cleft.
